A fix round outside this tree makes the closed branch of app/scripts/vercel-build.js safe to run twice in one build and compares the bytes of the gate page; it lands on main before the build, and the design changes only the open branch and builds on that behaviour. The owner wants the approved mockup matched one to one; «Без регистрации, заказов и данных»; G8 «б», G9 and G21 as PROGRESS.md «Owner gates» says. Read the design itself (not the author's summary) and check it against docs/quality-bar.md, the role file, WF-02 step 1b, WF-04, both blocks, both decisions, the look and app/ as built. In particular: every criterion of both blocks has a test in the «criterion → test» table with its damaged copies or mutants where the criterion is a rule, and a red-without-fix plan; nothing of PLAN M1 «Owner sees» for R1.2/R1.3 is missing; the G8 «б» / G9 split is a testable rule of the build, idempotent when the platform runs the build twice (decisions/0122 О5 (4)), refused in a git tree; the CSP (no inline script or style, no innerHTML, textContent only), ARCH §11.7, the word ban of decision 0074 item 6 and decision 0083 item 7 are rules with tests; the demo stores nothing and calls no outside address; the ports keep parity with the originals; the sub-steps are small, each with its check, and the owners are right (FRONTEND-DEV, BACKEND-DEV, TEST-DESIGNER); the guard tests of earlier requirements that change have «was → became» rows and none is weakened; every failure path has a named behaviour; the design does not contradict the look (side by side) nor lower anything of REQ-108/REQ-109 as built. Repeat the trials of the design on a clean copy (a fresh git clone of base/M1CODE-20261119-01 outside the project, then the design's sketch steps; at least T-02, T-03, T-05, T-06, T-09, T-10, T-12 and T-13, plus any trial a finding needs) and report each with its command, result and whether it matches the design. The verdict follows the common severity scale of docs/workflows/handoffs.md (Critical, High and Medium block; Low may stand when it changes no outcome, with the place it should go); every finding has its place, the problem with evidence and a concrete fix. Rules: work only inside the Sai folder and the scratch folder of the session; no commit, push, tag, stash, reset, checkout, clean or branch switch in the project or in any copy, copies only by a fresh git clone; no path of the computer in a Sai file; the checker changes nothing in the project but this handoff and does not edit the design. summary: Verdict FAIL: one High finding (F1) and one Medium finding (F2) block; eight Low findings (F3–F10) do not block and go with the rework. The design is careful and, wherever I repeated it, true: every trial I ran on my own fresh clone of base/M1CODE-20261119-01 gave the design's numbers (T-01 to T-10, T-12, T-13). It fails on two things: it was measured against the tag only, while the fix round that its route puts on main before the build changes five of the guard files around it (one new rule there refuses the design's declaration file, one new test takes the name NPM-6, and criterion 16's diff would list the fix round's files); and the public set, which is what production serves, is tested only for what it leaves out, never for what it keeps (a greedy region cut drops the AI disclosure with every check green).

Pass A (is the design true about today's Sai), repeated on fresh clones outside the project: F2, F3 (exit 0 in 60 s, unit 45, int 36), F4 (hashes and commits), F5 and F6 (50 errors: 44 TS7006, 5 TS2339, 1 TS7053; the copy or server/vendor/** excluded → exit 0; without the declaration an importer pulls the copy back, 50; export names equal), F7–F10, F11–F12 (and my own comparison: the sketch lists equal the 118 forms written in the REQ-111 block), F13 (plus my own hostile bodies), F14 (also for the design's loadIntake(file = INTAKE_FILE) form, not only the sketch's probe module), F17–F20, F21–F22, F23, F24–F25, F26 (with my own trial page under the app's real CSP), F32, F33. Not repeated: T-11 (F27–F29), T-14 (F15), T-15 (F16): not asked, and no finding needs them. A.2, the shared mechanisms: the demo rows go through the one route loop and the middlewares of createApp (gate, body limit, preview host, fallback); the two branches of vercel-build share the git-tree refusal; the static map and the gate page stay; the design names each place.

Pass A.3 (the old tests after the replacement table, the mutants, the sub-steps): today's tests on the sketch give unit 42 of 45 (VB-1, VB-3, VB-4 red, VB-2 green without awaiting) and int 36 of 36, as F21 and F22; replacement row 8 applied to vercel-build.test.js on the sketch: VB-1…VB-4 green with await, the count of assert. calls 19 → 19. Rows 1–2, 6–7 and 9–12 need code the sketch does not hold (the chain, check-public, app.yml); read against the files at the tag they are right; against the fix round's files they are not all right (F1). Mutants applied by me: 26 of the design's kinds (public set M01–M08, M10 through PB-7, M06 in a throwaway clone; ports M44, M45, M46, M47 twice and three more BFS orders, one equivalent as F25 says; lint M26–M29; demo M11, M12, M17, M19), each seen, and one of my own, V01 (a greedy region cut), which every check of criterion 9 lets through (F2). Sub-steps: 21, small, each with its own check, owners as REQ-111's owner line says; B1 turns IB-1 red once the fix round is on main (F1).

Pass B (enough for the developer): signatures and data shapes are given for every new module, route, script and step, with their exit codes and output lines; failure paths E1–E21 say what is seen and what stays; protection stands in the same call (section 7); no implementation code (shapes, tables, exact command lines). Places still left to the developer: the region match (shortest or longest, F2), when the team avatars are redrawn (F5), the message of a request that fails at once (F4), and where the engine's declaration may stand once the fix round lands (F1).

Pass C (enough for the tests and acceptance): all 16 + 10 criteria have a row in section 9 with a design element, a test or a command and the damaged copies or mutants; I checked the catalogue against each rule of the criteria (the nine damaged pages and three built forms, seven text copies, 118 forms × three cases × six borders, П and the 17 twins, three tokens.css copies, eight intake copies, four vendored copies, the seven 400 codes and 413, the 22 forms and 16 twins of c10, the traps and twins of REQ-112 c3, c4 and c9) and the test file names equal the criteria's (AP-123). Gaps: the public set's kept content (F2), one count worded two ways (F3), E7 mapped to a step whose criterion does not name it (F4).

Pass D (enough for the checkers): the bar section names Q1–Q14 and R1–R3, each with how or why not; protection in the same operation (section 7); no argument with decisions/: the defaults are answered by 0124 and the readings of 0123 are used (О3, О15 and V1, V2, V3, V4, J1, J2, J6, I2, I5, I7, Q4, V6); one wording of 0124 О7 differs (F6, Low).

The task's points: PLAN M1 «Owner sees» for R1.2/R1.3 (the scene with four desks and «Вы», how it works, the order texts local only, the five-question demo with what Sai cannot build yet and «Описать идею», the AI disclosure, the test-mode line, RU/EN, the three themes) each has its files, keys and tests; the G8 «б» / G9 split is one constant each (PUBLIC_LANGS, ORDER_TEXTS_PUBLIC), idempotent on a second run and refused in a git tree, measured, but its output is only tested negatively (F2); the CSP, ARCH §11.7, decision 0074 item 6 and decision 0083 item 7 are rules with tests (check-public rows, PP-6, OP-6, the CSP and console recorders of LD-1 and ST-6, the commands of criterion 10); the demo stores nothing and calls no outside address (DP-2, DM-7, LD-8, the URL guard, connect-src 'self'); the ports keep parity (76 585 comparisons, 0 different); the guard rows weaken nothing at the tag; the look agrees side by side (9.1 geometry and formulas, 9.13 step table, 9.14 offsets, 9.16 text view and noscript sheet, 5.1 and 5.2 rules, 6.1 theme mechanism, 7.12 receipt), except the cssText sentence of its 5.1 item 3, which the design itself corrects (О11, measured true again); REQ-108 and REQ-109 as built are kept except the replacements the records allow (REQ-109 c8 and REQ-108 c11 by decisions/0123 О3).

findings.what: The route and B5 put the fix round of the app skeleton on main before the build (4.11: «the closed branch as the fix round leaves it on main»), but the replacement table and every guard fact were measured at the tag only (the designer's issue I6: «The fix round … was not seen»). The fix round changes five guard files around this design — npmrc.test.js, import-boundaries.test.js, ci-workflow.test.js, vercel-build.test.js and runbooks.test.js (its tree in the session's scratch folder: commit 48109e2 «WIP … squashed before push» plus working changes; ORCH's PROGRESS log line of 2026-11-19T16:54:05Z: «NPM-6 runs that grep inside the check», «IB-1 reads the files git tracks or would track»). Measured three conflicts. (a) The fix round's IB-1 adds a file rule: under app/server, app/api and app/worker every file that is not .js is red. On a fresh clone of the tag with only that test file taken from the fix round: 4 of 4 green; with server/vendor/picker-engine.js and server/vendor/picker-engine.d.ts added as 4.8 says: IB-1 red, «a file that is not .js: server/vendor/picker-engine.d.ts»; over the whole sketch the same single line. Row 5 says «no edit», and B1 would be red at a test outside its list. A plain move is no way out: the declaration in app/types/server/vendor with rootDirs [".", "types"] leaves tsc at exit 2 with the 50 errors (the import pulls the copy back in), so REQ-111 criterion 6 («tsc leaves the copy to its declaration file», measured with «a declaration beside it») and the fix round's rule cannot both hold without a design choice. (b) The fix round already has a test named NPM-6 in npmrc.test.js («NPM-6 no line under app/test is hit by the grep of criterion 2 for the skip, todo and only selectors»); the design names its new e2e-folder guard NPM-6 as well, and its counts (69 new unit tests, unit 114) are the tag's. (c) REQ-111 criterion 16 and REQ-112 criterion 10 read `git diff --stat base/M1CODE-20261119-01 -- app/test tools/test` and allow only the table's files and the new ones; once the fix round is merged after the tag, that diff also lists import-boundaries.test.js and runbooks.test.js (changed by the fix round, not by this run), so the command the design names for RELEASE-VALIDATOR cannot pass as written. The tag's line numbers of rows 1, 2, 5 and 9–12 move as well (IB's literal `RED.length, 53` is 161 in the fix round).
findings.needed: Measure the replacement table, the guard facts (F22) and the counts again against the tree the build starts from (the fix round as it lands on main), and give every guard that changes its «was → became» row. For (a): choose and measure a place or form of the engine's declaration that both REQ-111 criterion 6 and the fix round's IB-1 accept, or propose to ORCH a record for one narrow row of the file rule (exactly the declaration named beside an entry of app/vendored.json; every other non-.js file under app/server, app/api and app/worker stays red), with the damaged copy that keeps the rule (a second .d.ts or a .ts there is red). For (b): rename the new guard and recount sections 0, 10 and 19 on that main. For (c): say how criterion 16's and REQ-112 criterion 10's diff tells this run's changes from the fix round's (for example a second base named by ORCH's record at the merge of the fix round), so that RELEASE-VALIDATOR can run it literally.

findings.what: The public set is what production serves, and its tests prove only what it leaves out (no examples.html, no order_ key, no kk value, no marker, a second run equal, the gates-open copy equal), never what it keeps. stripRegions does not say that a region ends at its nearest end marker, while index.html and how.html hold two order regions each (block D or the second H3 panel, and the footer link). Measured with my own oracle on the sketch: a greedy match (my mutant V01, `[\s\S]*?` → `[\s\S]*`) gives exit 0, a byte-equal second run, 0 order_ keys, 0 kk values, no examples.html, no marker, no word hit and a byte-equal gates-open copy — every check of criterion 9 and of PB-1…PB-7 green — while the output index.html lost `</main>`, `<footer>` and the home link that stood between the two regions. On the real pages that span holds the footer's AI disclosure and the nav links (on how.html also the idea panel #describe-idea), so production would lose a place of criterion 1 with every check green: PP-4 checks those places on the local set only, and LD-9 checks on the public set the links, the languages, the 404 page, the demo list and the console, not the test-mode line, the disclosure, the scene or «Описать идею». The same gap hides a region that FRONTEND-DEV opens a few lines too early, around the disclosure: it is closed and not nested, so PB-6 passes.
findings.needed: Name the region match as the shortest one in 4.11 and add the greedy cut (V01) to section 13; give the public set positive checks: each page that differs equals its source with exactly the lines of its regions removed (PB-2), and the public pages keep what criterion 1 asks — the test-mode line and the AI disclosure with their texts, every href and src naming a file of the public set (this also catches a left link to the removed examples.html), that is, the rules of PP-2…PP-4 run on the output — and LD-9 sees on the public set the scene and its caption on index, how and demo and «Описать идею» opening /how.html#describe-idea; each with the mutant that kills it (the greedy cut; a region that encloses #ai-disclosure).

findings.what: The look's §11 (its lines 1368–1370) names three demo failure states: a server error, «no connection, or no answer within the page's time limit» (the offline message) and refused (4xx). The design's E-table names 500, 4xx and a bad body (E1) and «never answers» (E2), but not a request that fails at once (a network error), and LD-7 has no such case, so the message of a failed fetch is left to the developer. findings.needed: Name the network-error case in E2 with the look's message and an LD-7 case for it (a route that aborts); map E7 to DESIGN-QA's list of states, or to an e2e case with script off. Goes with the rework.

findings.needed: Say that the avatars are drawn at load and again after each theme change from the palette read once per change (as the stage), and name the check that sees it (a unit case like OV-7 or the theme step of LD-4). Goes with the rework.

findings.needed: Add REQ-108 criterion 2's count reference to the list for ORCH and the micro-amendment run, or say how its re-check reads the counts at the released commit. For ORCH.
